2610.10184.title: Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming
2610.10184.paper_summary: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.
2610.10184.paper_summary_zh: 開發生產排程的優化模型需要大量專家的努力。對大型語言模型（LLMs）的研究主要有兩個方向：專門針對自動建模的方式，主要是針對混合整數線性規劃，這通常依賴於專門的訓練或問題特定的架構，限制了工業應用；以及用於操作決策支持的代理人工智慧，這通常假設優化模型已經存在。本研究通過評估通用 LLMs 是否能在沒有任務特定訓練的情況下，作為代理來制定和實施約束編程模型，來橋接這兩個方向。單代理和多代理架構與模型上下文協議伺服器集成，該伺服器提供上下文感知的求解器文檔檢索，以減少實施過程中的幻覺。兩者與直接 LLM 基準進行比較，涵蓋了六個行業導向的問題，包括流動車間、作業車間、靈活作業車間和資源受限的倉庫排程，使用三個 LLM 並評估建模準確性、執行成功率、延遲和令牌消耗。公式化在目前的 LLM 中大致可行，而實施則是主要障礙。多代理工作流程將從直接 LLM 調用生成的正確運行腳本的比例從 14.8% 提高到 59.3%，在四個較不複雜的問題中達到 80.6%，而緊密耦合的內部物流模型仍然是一個未解的挑戰。
